name: Early Splat Termination
definition: An optimization for volume splatting that skips processing of voxels when the accumulated opacity at the target screen pixels is already full, analogous to early ray termination in ray casting.
summary: Early Splat Termination is a screen-space optimization that skips processing voxels when accumulated pixel opacity is full, distinguishing itself by culling entire splats based on pixel coverage rather than terminating ray traversal.
